αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
διεργάζομαι: to make an end of, kill, destroy
εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
θάπτω: to bury, to honour with funeral rites
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
κήδω: to trouble, distress, vex; mid. care for
καταλέγω: recount, tell at length and in order; enrol, enlist
κεῖμαι: to lie; to have been set/put (as perf. pass. of τίθημι)
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κονίω: to make dusty, cover with clouds of dust
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
λωτίζομαι: to choose for oneself, cull the best
μέμφομαι: to blame, censure, find fault with
μένω: to stay at home, stay where one is, not stir
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μισθόω: to let out for hire, farm out, let
παραλέγω: talk nonsense/beside the point; pluck out hair; sail along a coast
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
προσλαμβάνω: to take or receive in addition
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
σείω: to shake, move to and fro
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute
ταινιόω: to bind with a head-band, esp. as a victor
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
χαίρω: to rejoice, be glad, be delighted
χαρίζω: to do a favor, to oblige, to please
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀγοράζω: to be in the ἀγορά, to buy (in the ἀγορά)
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναβάλλω: (to throw up;) strike up (a song); delay
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀποκρίνω: to separate, set apart; mid. answer
ἀρέσκω: (to make good, make up), to please
ἀσπάζομαι: to welcome kindly, bid welcome, greet
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐπάρχω: rule over, rule besides; to be governor of; mid. pour first drops, serve
ἐπίκειμαι: lie on, to be closed, to lie nearby (off the coast of)
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ἱδρύω: to make to sit down, to seat
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
